'''Ranor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], who was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] along with his apprentices for a supposed betrayal.
